cap: Torsion and epididymitis both cause a red, swollen, painful scrotum, so warmth and swelling settle nothing. The discriminators are the onset, the position of the testis, the cremasteric reflex, the response to lifting the testis and Doppler flow. In a bell-clapper testis, twisting closes the thin-walled veins first, so the testis congests and undergoes hemorrhagic infarction unless the cord is untwisted within hours.
